title: ZipDrift: Generating Multimodal Short-Horizon MPC Costs with One-Step Drifting Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Short-horizon model predictive control (MPC) is fast but myopic. ZipMPC compensates by learning a context-dependent correction of the short-horizon cost that imitates a long-horizon expert. We observe that the optimal correction is often multimodal: when a slower opponent can be passed on either side, good corrections of opposite sign coexist, and the expert's choice between them hinges on tiny cost differences. Deterministic regression then averages modes or inherits inconsistent expert tie-breaking. We propose ZipDrift, which trains a one-step drifting generator over MPC cost corrections, tilted toward low closed-loop cost and learned only from cost evaluations of candidate corrections, without differentiating through the optimiser. A few generated candidates are ranked by a learned critic, and the model-based MPC then enforces dynamics and constraints. translated_title: ZipDrift：利用一步漂移模型生成多模态短时域MPC代价
translated_abstract: 短时域模型预测控制（MPC）速度快但目光短浅。ZipMPC通过学习一种依赖于上下文的短时域代价修正来弥补这一缺陷，该修正模仿长时域专家的行为。我们观察到最优修正往往是多模态的：当较慢的对手既可从左侧也可从右侧超越时，符号相反的良好修正同时存在，而专家在两者之间的选择取决于微小的代价差异。在这种情况下，确定性回归会平均各个模态，或继承专家不一致的平局抉择。我们提出ZipDrift，它在MPC代价修正上训练一个一步漂移生成器，该生成器向低闭环代价倾斜，且仅通过候选修正的代价评估来学习，无需对优化器进行微分。少量生成的候选由学习到的评论家进行排序，随后基于模型的MPC强制执行动力学和约束。在从ZipMPC衍生出的运动学超车基准测试中，53%的上下文是双模态的……
tldr: 该论文提出ZipDrift，通过训练一个向低闭环代价倾斜的一步漂移生成器来产生多模态的MPC代价修正候选，再由学习到的评论家排序选优，解决了确定性回归在多模态场景下平均各模态或继承专家不一致平局决策的问题。
